messages:
Marta Alvarez: Heads-up — the API ref example for POST /v1/translate shows \"documents\" as an object. The actual API accepts an array and allows null for streaming fallback. I opened a tiny PR to correct examples and add a nullable-array schema. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4527
Jon Patel: Is this just the example or also the OpenAPI schema?
Marta Alvarez: Both. The example in the HTML was wrong and the YAML had documents: object in one spot (copy-paste). Suggest updating requestBody to: documents: { type: array, items: { type: string }, nullable: true } and syncing JS/Curl snippets.
Carla Nguyen: Can you paste a suggested curl + JS snippet? I'll pick it up in the docs build. Also we should document behavior: documents=null => server treats as streaming input (legacy), documents=[] => explicit empty set.
Jon Patel: Quick snippets below — tweak as needed:

curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/translate\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"documents\":[\"first doc\",\"second doc\"],\"target_lang\":\"fr\"}'

// JS
const res = await client.post('/v1/translate', { documents: [\"first doc\", \"second doc\"], target_lang: 'fr' });
console.log(await res.json());

Marta Alvarez: Perfect. Also add migration note under \"API compatibility\": older SDKs (<0.3.0) accepted a single string for documents; modern SDKs require an array or null. Recommend wrapping single string into [str] with sample code.
Ben Foster: I'll update the OpenAPI YAML, fix the HTML examples, and add the migration blurb. Plan to push in the hour.
docs-bot: Automated check — PR 4527 created: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4527 :white_check_mark:
Marta Alvarez: Can you also sweep /v1/embeddings? It has a similar copy-paste showing object.
Ben Foster: On it — will sweep both endpoints and update the example response to include tokens_used (we added that last month).
Carla Nguyen: I'll review once the PR is up. If you want me to run a local docs build, ping me. :thumbsup:
Jon Patel: Added small checklist item to PR for response shape and SDK snippet sync.
Marta Alvarez: Thanks — will mark resolved once merged. :white_check_mark:
